content: OCI Python SDK (pip package 'oci', latest 2.182.0) provides oci.cloud_guard.CloudGuardClient for Cloud Guard posture findings (list_problems(compartment_id=...), list_detector_recipes, list_responder_recipes) and Security Zones. Auth: API-signing-key config dict (tenancy OCID, user OCID, PEM private key, fingerprint, region). Create/Update/Delete restricted to Cloud Guard's reporting region; Read (list_problems) works from any region. Already a pinned backend dependency (oci>=2.181.1); backend/oci_ingest.py already has a mocked stub with this exact config shape and a commented-out CloudGuardClient call, targeting security_events not cloud_findings.
